# The ratchet: packages that are permitted to import non-keep deprecated
# packages, one `<importer> -> <imported>  # reason` per line.
#
# Living packages must not depend on packages deprecated/PACKAGES drops without
# a keep line. A keep line in deprecated/PACKAGES permits importing that package;
# it is never permission for that package's test dependencies to import non-keep
# retired packages. Every lift out of nsprint eliminates one or more edges.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestLivingPackagesDoNotImportDroppedDeprecatedPackages
# checks it in both directions: an unlisted edge is a red run, and a listed edge
# whose import has been removed is also a red run.
#
# ceiling: 13

internal/nsprint/fn -> internal/nsprint/life  # test fixtures in fn/probe_sets_functional_test.go
internal/nsprint/fn -> internal/nsprint/taskcard  # test fixtures in fn/probe_sets_functional_test.go
internal/nsprint/fn -> internal/nsprint/ws  # test fixtures in fn/probe_sets_functional_test.go
internal/nsprint/fn -> internal/nsprint/ws/wstest  # test fixtures in fn/probe_sets_functional_test.go
internal/nsprint/store -> internal/nsprint/card  # acl_cards_test.go and acl_epoch_test.go test card storage
internal/nsprint/store -> internal/nsprint/taskcard  # acl_cards_test.go and acl_epoch_test.go test taskcard records
internal/nsprint/store -> internal/nsprint/ws  # acl_cards_test.go and acl_epoch_test.go test workspace streams
